    hh = len(g); ww = len(g[0])
    j0 = next(j for j in range(ww) if len({g[i][j] for i in range(hh)}) == 1)
    A = [r[:j0] for r in g]; B = [r[j0 + 1:] for r in g]
    ca = collections.Counter(c for r in A for c in r)
    cb = collections.Counter(c for r in B for c in r)
    s = sorted(set(ca) & set(cb), key=lambda c: -(ca[c] + cb[c]))[0]
    out = [[3 if (A[i][j] == s and B[i][j] == s) else s

    if g is not grid:
